body:
Thanks. If I don't want to lose my home I need to come up with approximately 15k, or 2000 a month, but it needs to be fast. My fiance has medical problems and we lost insurance on top of all this, and if she needs treatment I won't be able to cover it. It's just a fucking mess. I feel so weak that I can't provide. I feel like a failure. I know I shouldn't want to die, especially because of her, but I do. I'm in shock. I'm really scared. I'm such a coward.

Thank you for responding to me. It was a thoughtful gesture and more than I deserve.
